about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the world of Arc's Glitch Defender with the official soundtrack, a collection of our best musical creations chosen just for you.

We’ve carefully curated this album to take you on a journey through different styles and genres. You'll find pulsing rock, driving techno, and synth melodies, all arranged with a unifying synthwave-inspired sound. Each high-BPM track was crafted to match the energy of the game and fuel the action.

Additionally, the album includes a special bonus: a slower, more emotional version of the official theme song. This heartfelt track was a massive inspiration for the game’s story and setting. We hope it resonates with you just as much as it did with us.

Relive the excitement of the game and discover the emotional heart behind its world. We hope you enjoy the music!
